result.title: Back to Raw Motion: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers for Text-to-Motion and Exact Conditional Generation
result.comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work (equal contribution). Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/RawMo_site
result.summary: As generative models tackle larger and more complex datasets, learned codecs enable efficient generation through compact latent representations, but may lose details and cannot guarantee exact preservation of given conditions. Generating directly in the original data space avoids errors introduced by the codec. Recent advances in image generation demonstrate that pixel diffusion can produce high-quality samples at practical computational costs. Inspired by these advances, we conduct a preliminary study of pixel diffusion, demonstrating its potential for adaptation to motion generation. Building on these findings, we present RawMo, a framework that brings text-to-motion generation to raw motion space. Our Motion Diffusion Transformer (MiT) models local skeletal structures and whole-body dynamics, while refining motion across frames to improve temporal consistency. Working directly in raw motion space further allows our high-noise text-motion alignment loss (HiNCE) to improve text consistency without intermediate motion decoding. RawMo supports multiple motion-conditioning tasks with a single conditional model while preserving given motion conditions exactly. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show the best text alignment among compared methods and competitive motion quality, with ablations confirming the benefits of MiT and HiNCE.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究 text-to-motion 生成，提出在原始运动空间而非学习到的 codec 隐空间中进行扩散，用 Motion Diffusion Transformer 建模局部骨架与整体动力学，并设计高噪声阶段的文本对齐损失 HiNCE，使单一条件模型可完成多种运动条件任务并精确保留给定条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「绕过 codec 隐空间以避免细节损失」与「不经中间解码、在高噪声阶段直接做条件对齐监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区是否保留任务必要视觉细节、以及直接对隐状态施加条件监督提供可核查线索，但任务与多模态推理相距较远。
